workflow.name: Web Application Evidence and Program Gate — Balanced v2.4
workflow.description: Web-focused scope, architecture, external flow, dual hypothesis runs, root-cause deduplication, independent verification, isolated PoC, exact program eligibility, and relative ranking. Import-valid v2.4: globally unique stage output keys, one consume-all dedup boundary, immutable program extras after dedup, deterministic mapping, non-lossy pre-verification consolidation, and explicit Web3 fork inputs. Balanced v2.4 restores one pre-verification coverage and root-cause consolidation barrier: every hypothesis branch completes before expensive verification, canonical candidates then fan out independently to final emission, and OpenKritt post-processing performs final finding deduplication and ranking.

steps.name: Freeze web program scope contract
Map web architecture and trust boundaries
steps.content:
Map in-scope production web/app components, ingress and routing, authentication/session boundaries, APIs, jobs/queues, databases, file/object stores, outbound integrations, secrets/privileged identities, and deployment evidence. Cite construction/configuration/registration paths. Separate repository evidence, supplied deployment facts, and gaps. Return one architecture record; no findings.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

steps.name: Map evidenced web entrypoints
steps.content:
Map distinct in-scope production HTTP, GraphQL, RPC, WebSocket, webhook, upload, callback, and externally supplied event entrypoints. Prove route/handler registration and network exposure from supplied evidence. Identify actor, auth requirement, controlled input, state/privilege effect, and candidate accepted impacts. Do not infer live exposure from framework conventions or hostnames. Mark proven/conditional/unproven and preserve gaps.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

steps.name: Trace web security flows
steps.content: Trace one materially distinct production flow from {{surface_entrypoint_label}} through ingress/proxy assumptions, parsing/canonicalization, authentication/session/CSRF, authorization, validation, business logic, database/queue, outbound request, file/process/parser, and terminal effect. Capture async/retry/transaction/partial-failure behavior and what remains attacker-controlled at the sink. Return ordered path:line:symbol evidence. No findings.

steps.name: Web hypotheses A: identity, injection, trust boundaries
steps.content: Fresh-context hypothesis run for {{flow_flow_summary}}. Emit only code-grounded hypotheses relevant to this flow: auth/session bypass, object/tenant authorization, confused deputy, injection/unsafe interpretation, SSRF/URL confusion, path/file access, upload/parser/deserialization, request smuggling assumptions, secret/data disclosure, and trust-boundary failures. One root cause per record with precise actor sequence, locations, guards, falsification target, and accepted-impact candidate.

steps.name: Web hypotheses B: workflow, concurrency, asymmetry
steps.content: Independent fresh-context run for {{flow_flow_summary}}. Examine state-machine abuse, replay/idempotency, race/TOCTOU, partial rollback, cache/policy mismatch, alternate content types/routes, callback/retry effects, and bounded computational or state amplification. Require a specific root cause and non-volume-dependent effect for availability claims. Include exact verification locations and falsification target.

steps.name: Deduplicate web root causes
steps.content:
Cluster {{multi_output_depth_4}} by faulty operation/missing guard, attacker primitive, invariant, effect, and fix. Generate stable fingerprints, preserve all trigger paths and gaps, and prioritize evidence-rich candidates. Remove duplicates, unsupported deployment assumptions, scanner-only observations, volume-only DDoS, and hardening items.

Coverage rule: consolidate only after every hypothesis branch has completed. Emit every distinct code-grounded root cause that still warrants hostile verification. Triage priority is advisory metadata only; never discard a candidate solely because it is not labeled high priority.

steps.name: Independently verify and reproduce candidate
Apply program gate and emit progressive finding
